prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 9 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1068; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- Two similar charges on the same day are being checked.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting headache, dizziness, and difficulty concentrating. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms and with a concussion. Over nine visits, care included symptom monitoring, cognitive and vestibular assessment, and graduated activity guidance. The course of recovery was somewhat longer than typically expected for this type of injury, and progress was gradual rather than linear. Examination findings, including balance testing and reported symptom scores, support the diagnosis of concussion, while certain neurological screening tests returned normal results. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known from the patient history. Billing records for two similar services on the same date are under review, and this summary does not address those charges. Current assessment indicates ongoing improvement, with return to full activity anticipated as symptoms continue to resolve.
